node.title: Re^3: Selecting Ranges of 2-Dimensional Data
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What is the purpose of using alias in this line alias my $r = $$range[$i];

It was just to shorten code, and play around with [mod://Data::Alias] a bit. Since [LanX] [id://1224755|showed] that the module isn't necessary (because the elements of [doc://@_] are already aliases), I removed it and posted an updated getsubset [id://1224759|here].

I hope you don't resent me "embellishing" on your script.

Not at all, do whatever you need to figure stuff out, that's why I post publicly :-)
